activity.role: Dramatist and German-language co-adaptor of the 1928 premiere of Die Dreigroschenoper
activity.notes: The Threepenny Opera premiered at Berlin's Theater am Schiffbauerdamm on 31 August 1928. Brecht's German adaptation belongs to a collaboration with Elisabeth Hauptmann (translation and textual work) and Kurt Weill (music), ultimately drawing on John Gay. This is a representative cultural Activity in the Weimar Republic, not a claim of sole authorship or political office.
